title: A review on the sulfur ylide-mediated Corey–Chaykovsky reaction: a powerful approach to natural product synthesis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37125-37151
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04921K, Review Article

Ammara, Asim Mansha, Samreen Gul Khan, Ameer Fawad Zahoor, Muhammad Jawwad Saif, Bushra Parveen, Muhammad Athar Saeed, Aijaz Rasool Chaudhry, Ahmad Irfan, Muhammad Abbas
The current review summarizes the recent applications of Corey–Chaykovsky reaction toward the total synthesis of several classes of natural products i.e., alkaloids, terpenoids, depsipeptides, polyketides and amino acids, etc.
